messages:
ops-bot: Notice: AU-SYD1 (au-syd1) will open a limited preview for Kaplan-K1200 Dedicated mini-pools on Tue 2026-06-01 07:00 AEST. This is a capacity-preview for memory-heavy inference. :bell:
mina: (product) Preview is invite-only. Target workloads: long-context retrieval and multimodal fusion. Seats are limited.
ash: (infra) Hardware note: Kaplan-K1200 = 4x96GB GPUs with ultra-wide interconnect. We added a "cold-reserve" tag to nodes for rotational warm pooling. Expect ~12% throughput uplift on sparsely batched workloads.
ravi: (ops) Scheduling changes for preview: enable rotational mini-pool windows (2h warm, 4h cold) to balance utilization across customers. During warm windows, reserved tenants get scheduling bias.
tia: (ops) Policy tweak for preview: minimum reservation length for Kaplan mini-pools = 3 days (preview-only). This is shorter than usual to let teams validate quickly.
billing-bot: Billing (internal): Kaplan reserved unit = $Z/hr committed; mini-pool on-demand = $W/hr. Cold-reserve discounted rate applies during cold windows (approx -20%). Full billing details in runbook.
ash: infra config snippet (ops reference):
```
# au-syd1 Kaplan mini-pool config
pool_name: au-syd1-kaplan-mini-preview
node_type: kaplan-k1200
pool_mode: rotational-mini
warm_window_secs: 7200   # 2h
cold_window_secs: 14400  # 4h
min_reservation_days_preview: 3
fairshare_weights: reserved=260, shared=80
alert: capacity.kaplan.rotation_spill
```

mina: rollout schedule: 07:00 AEST preview open, 48h reserved-priority, monitor metrics for 10 days, then decide expansion.
ops-bot: Important: autoscaler packing now prefers Kaplan cold-reserve nodes only for batch-inference with <=4s startup. Real-time low-latency jobs will be steered to warm windows.
ravi: Oncall note: add alert group `capacity.kaplan.rotation_spill` to APAC oncall for the preview. If spill > 12% sustained for 5m, escalate to oncall.
tia: CS action: notify invited customers with guidance on rotational windows and expected differences in latency across warm/cold windows. Sales to coordinate uplift offers.
sales-bot: Sales offering: early-adopter discount and migration assistance for approved customers. Use Capacity Request Form in runbook.
platform: Infra action: will push NUMA-friendly allocator and interconnect tuning to staging tonight; production push scheduled 03:00 AEST pre-open.
ops-bot: Docs & runbook (internal): https://intra.redwood.ai/docs/dedicated/kaplan-k1200-au-syd1-preview - internal only. Report regressions in #eng-runtime and tag @nash/@ravi. :eyes:
